t2.title: Practical skills vs academic subjects
t2.prompt:
You are participating in an online discussion for students and teachers.

The question is:

"Should schools focus more on practical life skills than academic subjects?"

Post your response, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample: Whether schools should prioritise practical life skills over academic subjects is a hotly debated topic, and I believe the honest answer lies somewhere in between. On the one hand, there is a compelling argument that traditional academic subjects alone do not fully prepare young people for adult life. Many students leave school able to solve complex equations yet unable to manage a budget, cook a healthy meal, or understand a contract. Teaching skills such as financial literacy and basic cooking would therefore equip them for the real world. On the other hand, we must not underestimate the value of academic knowledge. Subjects like mathematics, science and literature develop critical thinking and open doors to higher education and skilled careers. All things considered, I do not think schools should choose one over the other. The ideal solution is to strike a balance — maintaining rigorous academic teaching while weaving essential life skills into the curriculum, so that students leave school both knowledgeable and genuinely prepared for life.
t2.sampleA1: Some people say schools must teach life skills. Some people say academic subjects are more important. I think both are good. Life skills help us to cook and to save money. But maths and reading are important too. So schools must teach both. This is my opinion.
t2.sampleA2: Some people think schools should teach more life skills, like cooking and money. Other people think academic subjects are more important. In my opinion, both are important. Life skills help students in real life. But subjects like maths and science help students go to university. In conclusion, I think schools should teach practical skills and academic subjects.
t2.sampleB1: This is a hotly debated topic. Some people think schools should teach more practical life skills, but I do not fully agree. First of all, life skills like cooking and saving money are very useful in real life, and many students do not learn them at home. On the other hand, academic subjects like maths and science are also important because they help students think and go to university. So I think schools need both. In conclusion, schools should teach practical skills, but they should not stop teaching academic subjects, because students need both for a good future.
t2.sampleB2: This is such an interesting question, and honestly I can see both sides. On the one hand, I completely understand why people say schools should focus more on practical skills. So many of us leave school knowing how to solve an equation but with no idea how to manage a budget or write a CV. That said, I don't think we should throw out academic subjects. Maths, science and literature teach you how to think, solve problems and keep learning — skills you need in almost any career. On top of that, academic qualifications are still what open doors to university and good jobs. So for me, it isn't really about choosing one or the other. The smartest approach is to strike a balance: keep strong academic teaching but also make room for practical lessons like cooking, budgeting and first aid. That way, students leave school ready for exams and for real life. What does everyone else think?
t2.uzSample:
Maktablar akademik fanlardan ko'ra amaliy hayotiy ko'nikmalarga ko'proq e'tibor berishi kerakmi degan savol — <mark>qizg'in muhokama qilinadigan mavzu</mark>, va menimcha halol javob ikkovi o'rtasida yotadi.

<mark>Bir tomondan</mark>, an'anaviy akademik fanlarning o'zi yoshlarni kattalar hayotiga to'liq tayyorlamasligi haqida <mark>ishonchli dalil</mark> bor. Ko'p o'quvchilar maktabni murakkab tenglamalarni yechishni bilib, ammo byudjetni boshqarish, sog'lom ovqat pishirish yoki shartnomani tushunishni bilmay tugatadi. Shu sababli moliyaviy savodxonlik va oddiy oshpazlik kabi ko'nikmalarni o'rgatish ularni <mark>haqiqiy hayotga tayyorlaydi</mark>.

<mark>Boshqa tomondan</mark>, biz akademik bilimning qadrini past baholamasligimiz kerak. Matematika, fan va adabiyot kabi fanlar tanqidiy fikrlashni rivojlantiradi va oliy ta'lim hamda malakali kasblarga yo'l ochib beradi.

<mark>Hammasini hisobga olganda</mark>, menimcha maktablar birini boshqasidan afzal ko'rmasligi kerak. Ideal yechim — muvozanatni saqlash, ya'ni qat'iy akademik ta'limni saqlab qolgan holda o'quv dasturiga muhim hayotiy ko'nikmalarni singdirish, shunda o'quvchilar maktabni ham bilimli, ham hayotga chinakam tayyor holda tugatadi.
t2.uzSampleA1: Ba'zilar maktablar hayotiy ko'nikmalarni o'rgatishi kerak deydi. Ba'zilar akademik fanlar muhimroq deydi. Menimcha ikkalasi ham yaxshi. Hayotiy ko'nikmalar bizga ovqat pishirish va pul tejashga yordam beradi. Lekin matematika va o'qish ham muhim. Shuning uchun maktablar ikkalasini ham o'rgatishi kerak. Bu mening fikrim.
t2.uzSampleA2: Ba'zilar maktablar ko'proq hayotiy ko'nikmalarni, masalan, ovqat pishirish va pulni o'rgatishi kerak deydi. Boshqalar akademik fanlar muhimroq deydi. Mening fikrimcha, ikkalasi ham muhim. Hayotiy ko'nikmalar o'quvchilarga real hayotda yordam beradi. Lekin matematika va fan kabi fanlar o'quvchilarga universitetga borishga yordam beradi. Xulosa qilib, menimcha maktablar amaliy ko'nikmalarni va akademik fanlarni o'rgatishi kerak.
t2.uzSampleB1: Bu qizg'in muhokama qilinadigan mavzu. Ba'zilar maktablar ko'proq amaliy hayotiy ko'nikmalarni o'rgatishi kerak deydi, lekin men to'liq rozi emasman. Avvalo, ovqat pishirish va pul tejash kabi hayotiy ko'nikmalar real hayotda juda foydali, va ko'p o'quvchilar ularni uyda o'rganmaydi. Boshqa tomondan, matematika va fan kabi akademik fanlar ham muhim, chunki ular o'quvchilarga fikrlash va universitetga borishga yordam beradi. Shuning uchun menimcha maktablarga ikkalasi ham kerak. Xulosa qilib, maktablar amaliy ko'nikmalarni o'rgatishi kerak, lekin akademik fanlarni o'qitishni to'xtatmasligi kerak, chunki o'quvchilarga yaxshi kelajak uchun ikkalasi ham zarur.
t2.uzSampleB2: Bu juda qiziq savol, va rostini aytsam, men ikkala tomonni ham tushunaman. Bir tomondan, odamlar nega maktablar ko'proq amaliy ko'nikmalarga e'tibor berishi kerak deyishini to'liq tushunaman. Ko'pchiligimiz maktabni tenglamani yechishni bilib, ammo byudjetni boshqarish yoki rezyume yozishni bilmay tugatamiz. Shunga qaramay, menimcha biz akademik fanlarni chiqarib tashlamasligimiz kerak. Matematika, fan va adabiyot sizga fikrlash, muammolarni hal qilish va o'rganishda davom etishni o'rgatadi — bu ko'nikmalar deyarli har qanday kasbda kerak. Bundan tashqari, akademik malakalar hali ham universitetga va yaxshi ishlarga yo'l ochadi. Shuning uchun men uchun bu birini yoki boshqasini tanlash haqida emas. Eng aqlli yondashuv — muvozanatni saqlash: kuchli akademik ta'limni saqlab qolish, lekin oshpazlik, byudjet tuzish va birinchi tibbiy yordam kabi amaliy darslarga ham joy ajratish. Shunda o'quvchilar maktabni imtihonlarga ham, real hayotga ham tayyor holda tugatadi. Boshqalar nima deb o'ylaydi?

t11.title: Informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who visited the museum with you. Tell your friend about the manager's email, give your opinion about the planned changes, and ask what they think.
t11.sample: Hi Mia, Hope you're keeping well! Remember our trip to the museum last weekend? Well, I've just had an email from the manager — they're planning to add interactive exhibits, free weekend tours and even a little café! Honestly, I think it's a fantastic idea. What's your take on it? Let me know! Cheers, Leo
t11.sampleA1: Hi Ben, The museum will change. There will be new games and a café. There will be free tours too. I think this is good. Do you like it? Please tell me. Sam
t11.sampleA2: Hi Ben, I got an email from the museum. They want to add interactive games, a café and free tours at the weekend. I think it is a good idea. What do you think? Please write back. Sam
t11.sampleB1: Hi Ben, I have some news about the museum we visited. The manager sent an email. They want to add interactive exhibitions, a small café and free tours at the weekend. I think these changes are a great idea. What do you think about them? Please tell me soon. Best wishes, Sam
t11.sampleB2: Hi Aziz, Guess what? I've just heard from the museum we went to — they're planning to add interactive exhibits, a cosy little café and free weekend tours! Personally, I reckon it's a brilliant idea, especially the café. But I'd love to know what you think — do you go along with that? Let me know! Cheers, Dilnoza
t11.uzSample:
Salom Miya,

Umid qilamanki, ishlaring yaxshi! O'tgan dam olish kunlari muzeyga borganimiz esingdami? Hozirgina menejerdan xat oldim — ular interaktiv eksponatlar, dam olish kunlari bepul ekskursiyalar va hatto kichkina kafe <mark>qo'shishni rejalashtirmoqda</mark>! Rostini aytsam, menimcha bu <mark>zo'r g'oya</mark>. Bu haqda fikring qanday? Menga xabar ber!

Salom bilan,
Leo
t11.uzSampleA1: Salom Ben, Muzey o'zgaradi. Yangi o'yinlar va kafe bo'ladi. Bepul ekskursiyalar ham bo'ladi. Menimcha bu yaxshi. Senga yoqadimi? Menga ayt. Sam
t11.uzSampleA2: Salom Ben, Muzeydan xat oldim. Ular interaktiv o'yinlar, kafe va dam olish kunlari bepul ekskursiyalar qo'shmoqchi. Menimcha bu yaxshi g'oya. Sen nima deb o'ylaysan? Javob yoz. Sam
t11.uzSampleB1: Salom Ben, biz borgan muzey haqida menda yangilik bor. Menejer xat yubordi. Ular interaktiv ko'rgazmalar, kichik kafe va dam olish kunlari bepul ekskursiyalar qo'shmoqchi. Menimcha bu o'zgarishlar ajoyib g'oya. Ular haqida nima deb o'ylaysan? Tezroq menga ayt. Yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Sam
t11.uzSampleB2: Salom Aziz, bilasanmi? Biz borgan muzeydan hozirgina xabar oldim — ular interaktiv eksponatlar, shinam kichik kafe va dam olish kunlari bepul ekskursiyalar qo'shmoqchi! Shaxsan menimcha bu ajoyib g'oya, ayniqsa kafe. Lekin sen nima deb o'ylashingni bilishni istardim — bunga rozimisan? Menga xabar ber! Salom bilan, Dilnoza

t12.title: Formal letter · to manager
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the museum manager. Explain what you liked about the museum, give your opinion about the planned improvements, and suggest one or two more ideas that could make the museum even better.
t12.sample: Dear Sir or Madam, Thank you for your email inviting feedback on the museum's proposed improvements. During my recent visit, what I enjoyed most was the fascinating local history exhibition and the calm, welcoming atmosphere throughout the building. In my opinion, the planned changes are a commendable initiative. Interactive exhibitions would appeal to younger visitors, while a café would give families a pleasant place to relax between galleries. Looking ahead, I would like to suggest a couple of further ideas. Introducing evening opening hours once a month could attract working visitors, and a small gift shop selling local crafts might generate additional income. Thank you for taking my suggestions into consideration. Yours faithfully, Leo Martin
t12.sampleA1: Dear Sir or Madam, I liked the museum. The history room was very good. The new café and games are a good idea. I have an idea too. Please open in the evening. Please make a shop for gifts. Thank you. Yours faithfully, Sam Taylor
t12.sampleA2: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing about my visit to the museum. I liked the history exhibition very much. I think the new café and interactive games are a good idea. I have some ideas too. You could open in the evening sometimes. You could also add a small gift shop. Thank you. Yours faithfully, Sam Taylor
t12.sampleB1: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing about my recent visit to the museum. I really enjoyed the history exhibition and the friendly staff. I think the planned changes are a very good idea. The interactive exhibitions will be fun for children, and the café will be a nice place to rest. I also have some ideas. Maybe you could open in the evening once a month, so more people can visit. You could also add a small gift shop. I think many visitors would like this. Thank you very much. Yours faithfully, Sam Taylor
t12.sampleB2: Dear Sir or Madam, Thank you for your email asking for feedback on the museum's plans. I very much enjoyed my visit last weekend — the history exhibition was fascinating, and the staff were extremely helpful. In my opinion, the proposed changes are excellent. The interactive exhibitions will appeal to younger visitors, and a café is exactly what families need for a short break. The free weekend tours are also a nice touch. Looking ahead, I would like to suggest a couple more ideas. Firstly, opening late one evening a month could attract people who work during the day. Secondly, a small gift shop selling local crafts would be popular and could generate additional income. Thank you for taking my feedback on board. I look forward to hearing about your plans. Yours faithfully, Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli janob yoki xonim,

Muzeyni yaxshilash bo'yicha takliflarga fikr bildirishga taklif qilgan xatingiz uchun tashakkur. So'nggi tashrifim davomida menga eng ko'p yoqqan narsa — maftunkor mahalliy tarix ko'rgazmasi va bino bo'ylab hukm surgan xotirjam, samimiy muhit edi.

Mening fikrimcha, rejalashtirilgan o'zgarishlar <mark>maqtovga sazovor tashabbus</mark>. Interaktiv ko'rgazmalar yosh tashrifchilarni jalb qiladi, kafe esa oilalarga zallar orasida dam olish uchun yoqimli joy beradi.

Kelajakka nazar tashlab, bir nechta qo'shimcha g'oya taklif qilmoqchiman. Oyiga bir marta <mark>kechki ish soatlarini</mark> joriy etish ishlaydigan tashrifchilarni jalb qilishi mumkin, mahalliy hunarmandchilik buyumlarini sotadigan kichik <mark>sovg'a do'koni</mark> esa <mark>qo'shimcha daromad keltirishi</mark> mumkin.

Takliflarimni inobatga olganingiz uchun tashakkur.

Hurmat bilan,
Leo Martin
t12.uzSampleA1: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, Muzey menga yoqdi. Tarix xonasi juda yaxshi edi. Yangi kafe va o'yinlar yaxshi g'oya. Menda ham g'oya bor. Iltimos, kechqurun oching. Iltimos, sovg'a do'koni qiling. Rahmat. Hurmat bilan, Sam Taylor
t12.uzSampleA2: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, Muzeyga tashrifim haqida yozmoqdaman. Tarix ko'rgazmasi menga juda yoqdi. Menimcha yangi kafe va interaktiv o'yinlar yaxshi g'oya. Menda ham g'oyalar bor. Ba'zan kechqurun ochsangiz bo'ladi. Kichik sovg'a do'konini ham qo'shsangiz bo'ladi. Rahmat. Hurmat bilan, Sam Taylor
t12.uzSampleB1: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, Muzeyga so'nggi tashrifim haqida yozmoqdaman. Tarix ko'rgazmasi va samimiy xodimlar menga juda yoqdi. Menimcha rejalashtirilgan o'zgarishlar juda yaxshi g'oya. Interaktiv ko'rgazmalar bolalar uchun qiziqarli bo'ladi, kafe esa dam olish uchun yoqimli joy bo'ladi. Menda ham g'oyalar bor. Balki oyiga bir marta kechqurun ochasiz, shunda ko'proq odam keladi. Kichik sovg'a do'konini ham qo'shsangiz bo'ladi. Menimcha ko'p tashrifchi buni yoqtiradi. Katta rahmat. Hurmat bilan, Sam Taylor
t12.uzSampleB2: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, Muzey rejalari haqida fikr so'ragan xatingiz uchun tashakkur. O'tgan dam olish kunlaridagi tashrifim menga juda yoqdi — tarix ko'rgazmasi maftunkor edi, xodimlar esa juda yordamchi edi. Mening fikrimcha, taklif etilgan o'zgarishlar ajoyib. Interaktiv ko'rgazmalar yosh tashrifchilarni jalb qiladi, kafe esa oilalar uchun qisqa tanaffusda aynan kerak. Dam olish kunlaridagi bepul ekskursiyalar ham yoqimli qo'shimcha. Kelajakka nazar tashlab, yana bir nechta g'oya taklif qilmoqchiman. Birinchidan, oyiga bir kech kechroq ochish kunduzi ishlaydigan odamlarni jalb qilishi mumkin. Ikkinchidan, mahalliy hunarmandchilik buyumlarini sotadigan kichik sovg'a do'koni mashhur bo'lib, qo'shimcha daromad keltirishi mumkin. Fikrimni inobatga olganingiz uchun tashakkur. Rejalaringiz haqida eshitishni kutib qolaman. Hurmat bilan, Bekzod Aliyev

tasks.p1_context: You visited a local museum last weekend. A few days later, you received an email from the museum manager.
tasks.p1_scenario:
Dear Visitor,

Thank you for visiting our museum. We hope you enjoyed your experience.

We are planning to introduce several new attractions, including interactive exhibitions, free guided tours on weekends, and a small café inside the museum. Before making these changes, we would like to hear from our visitors.

What did you enjoy most about your visit? Do you think these new ideas would improve the museum? Is there anything else you would like us to add or change?

We look forward to receiving your suggestions.

Kind regards,

The Museum Manager
